PAYLOAD_KEK.description: Random string (32+ chars). Wraps per-event data keys — payload encryption at rest. Escrow it: if lost, encrypted data is unrecoverable.

CONTENT_HMAC_KEY.description: Random string (32+ chars). Signs export links and confirm tokens.

MCP_READ_TOKEN.description: Random string (32+ chars). Read scope — REST reads + the recall MCP connection.

MCP_PROPOSE_TOKEN.description: Random string (32+ chars). Propose scope — capture-plugin ingest + write MCP tools. Must differ from the read token.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Random string (32+ chars). Owner key — apply/discard, exports, purge, manual kicks.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google AI Studio key (aistudio.google.com), sent through your AI Gateway — free tier works.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: (Optional) GitHub token for the activity connector — raises API rate limits.

BRAIN_DB.description: D1 database: event log and derived memory.

BRAIN_RAW.description: R2 bucket: raw captures, exports and backups.

VECTORIZE.description: Vectorize index for semantic recall (768 dims, cosine).
